svg.title: Feature replay from one encoded sample
svg.desc: The mean over cell centers outside the annotated boxes is subtracted at half strength. The same features control the Mamba content and step-size projections in the auxiliary pass. Detection uses the unmodified encoded features.

svg.title: Boundary-State DETR
svg.desc: Decoder overview and a connected detail. Region states are weighted by their boundary probabilities and combined, read out and projected, then added to the original query. Training reuses the encoded map. Context-centered features provide both content and step size.

g.text: One feature map for content and step size
At each level, take each channel’s mean
over cells outside every GT box.
BCSA with the same query and bounds
Class, L1 and GIoU on the same targets
